'''Trinna Orani''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A crack shot, she attended a briefing conducted by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] alongside [[Carns Capra]], [[Denis Rygelli]], and [[Ben Spax]] on the procedures for establishing a Rebel cell structure on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-held [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
